Class CargoHold

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.CargoHold
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CargoHold extends Component
Represents a cargo hold component capable of storing goods with specific constraints. The cargo hold has a defined maximum capacity and can optionally accept special goods.
